comps.name: Peni Bunker
comps.style: Zone control around Peni's nest with strong sustain and team-up value
comps.why: Peni is the only S-tier Vanguard after her light nerf, and Rocket Network (Peni + Rocket) is the highest win-rate team-up in Season 11 ranked. Wild Wall (Groot + Mantis), Parker Power-Up (Peni + Spider-Man), Fantastic Amplifier (Mister Fantastic + Rocket) and Star Blossom (Mantis + Star-Lord) all stack on the same core.
comps.how_to_play: Lay webs, mines and nest on the objective and force the enemy to walk into your zone while Groot walls split their frontline. Duelists punish anyone who commits into the nest and the supports outlast the fight.
comps.counters: Banning Peni (banned in roughly 3 of 10 Gold+ games) or aerial pressure from Storm and Ultron that ignores the ground zone.

comps.name: Magik/Storm Dive
comps.style: Fast 2-2-2 dive onto the backline with high-mobility Duelists
comps.why: Season 11 cut sleeps, freezes and blinds, so divers get caught for less time, and Magik and Storm sit in S tier. Adam Warlock's buffed Storm team-up (100% speed) and Flawless Design with Ultron, plus Savage Slam (Hulk + Captain America) and Damisa-Yao (Black Panther + Storm), all post high win rates.
comps.how_to_play: Hulk and Captain America create space while Magik and Black Panther or Spider-Man collapse on a support, and Storm buffs and pressures from the air. Ultron and Adam keep divers alive and enable fast re-engages.
comps.counters: Hitscan anti-air such as Hela and tight peel with grouped supports.

comps.name: Ragnarok Brawl
comps.style: Close-range brawl built around Gorr with Asgardian and symbiote team-ups
comps.why: Gorr has the highest Duelist win rate in Season 11, and Ragnarok (Gorr + Hela) and Hive Mind (Gorr + Venom) are among the top team-ups. Angela's buffed ground form pairs with Loki (Odin's Unacknowledged), and Loki + Mantis (Vibrant Vitality) adds sustain.
comps.how_to_play: Push into short sightlines with Venom and Angela and let Gorr brawl with Hela securing kills from behind. Loki copies key abilities and both supports keep the frontline healthy through extended fights.
comps.counters: Long-range poke and kite comps that avoid close fights, or Hela/Storm pressure from range.

comps.name: Void Pentagram Brawl
comps.style: Aggressive melee brawl with portals, lifesteal and teleport rescues
comps.why: Void Pentagram (Magik + The Hood) is the most-played high win-rate team-up in Season 11 ranked. Jubilee's Vampiric Kin lifesteal for Blade rose to 40%, Bleed for Battle (Blade + Captain America) is strong, and Nightcrawler adds team-ups with Magik and Rogue.
comps.how_to_play: Use Hood and Magik portals to flood one point of the enemy line and win the brawl with lifesteal and burst. Nightcrawler can teleport endangered allies out after the engage.
comps.counters: Grouped teams with strong burst AoE or kiting heroes that refuse melee range.

comps.name: Air Superiority
comps.style: Aerial pressure from flying Duelists backed by flying supports
comps.why: Storm, Ultron and Iron Man are high-tier picks that ground-heavy comps struggle to reach, and Ultron + Adam Warlock is the second-best team-up by win rate. Cosmic Cyclone (Adam + Storm) and Storming Ignition (Storm + Human Torch) add more air synergy.
comps.how_to_play: Hold high ground and angles while the Vanguards hold space beneath, and rotate through the air faster than the enemy can follow. Fight where enemy hitscan sightlines are blocked.
comps.counters: Hitscan heroes, especially Hela, who is named as a strong counter to Storm, Ultron and Iron Man.
